name: Web Application
description: Standard SPA with authentication, navigation, and CRUD operations

scoutPrompts.frontend:
AUDIT SCOUT: Frontend Discovery for {{target_area}}

1. **Routes & Navigation**:
   - Discover all route definitions (React Router, Next.js, Vue Router, etc.)
   - Identify navigation components (sidebars, headers, tabs, breadcrumbs)
   - Map route → component relationships
   - Find layout wrapper components

2. **Authentication Pattern**:
   - Identify auth provider (Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS, Firebase, Supabase, custom)
   - Find auth context/hooks (useAuth, useSession, etc.)
   - Locate token storage mechanism (localStorage, cookies, memory)
   - Document guard/protection patterns (PrivateRoute, withAuth, middleware)
   - Find login/logout components and flows

3. **Page Components**:
   - List all page-level components with line counts
   - Document what each page does (from component analysis)
   - Identify shared components used across pages

4. **Feature Inventory** (per page):
   - Interactive elements (buttons, forms, modals, dropdowns)
   - Data displays (tables, lists, cards, charts)
   - State indicators (loading spinners, empty states, error boundaries)
   - Form validation patterns

5. **Selectors for Testing**:
   - data-testid attributes if present
   - Semantic selectors (role, aria-label)
   - Text-based selectors for buttons/links
   - CSS selectors as fallback

Return structured inventory with testable selectors.
scoutPrompts.backend:
AUDIT SCOUT: Backend Discovery for {{target_area}}

1. **API Layer**:
   - Identify API pattern (REST, GraphQL, tRPC, Convex, Firebase)
   - List all endpoints/functions relevant to target area
   - Document request/response shapes
   - Find API client configuration

2. **Database/State**:
   - Identify data store (SQL, NoSQL, Convex, Firebase, Supabase)
   - List tables/collections relevant to target area
   - Document field types and relationships
   - Find indexes and constraints

3. **Data Flow**:
   - Map which queries each page calls
   - Map which mutations each action triggers
   - Document expected response shapes
   - Identify real-time subscription patterns

4. **Authorization**:
   - Document role-based access controls
   - Find permission checks in API layer
   - Identify protected resources

Return structured inventory with API signatures.
scoutPrompts.credentials:
CREDENTIAL DISCOVERY:

1. Check environment files:
   - .env.local, .env.test, .env.development
   - Look for TEST_USER, TEST_EMAIL, TEST_PASSWORD patterns

2. Check fixture files:
   - cypress/fixtures/
   - tests/fixtures/
   - __tests__/
   - seed scripts

3. Check documentation:
   - README.md for test credentials
   - docs/ folder for testing guides

4. Identify auth method to determine credential format:
   - Email/password
   - OAuth (need mock tokens?)
   - API keys
   - Magic links

Return: { method, credentials_location, example_format }

tests.name: Login Flow
verify: User is redirected to authenticated area

tests.name: Logout Flow
tests.purpose: Verify user can sign out successfully
verify: User is redirected to public area

tests.name: Auth Guard
tests.purpose: Verify protected routes redirect unauthenticated users
steps: Attempt to navigate directly to protected route
verify: Original destination is preserved for post-login redirect

tests.name: Primary Navigation
tests.purpose: Verify all main nav items work

tests.name: Deep Link Support
steps: Navigate directly to each route via URL

tests.name: Page Load Data
tests.purpose: Verify data loads on page render
steps: Wait for loading state to clear

tests.name: Empty State
steps: Navigate to page with no data
verify: Call to action present if applicable

tests.name: Error State
tests.purpose: Verify error handling on data fetch failure
steps: Trigger data fetch error (if possible via mocking)
